name: beavermaps
description: Campus map: search, browse, building cards and walking directions.

scripts.deploy: if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard src server)" ]; then echo 'deploy: refusing - commit first. fly deploy uploads the working tree, not HEAD, so what went live would be a tree no commit and no CI run has seen.' >&2; exit 1; fi; [ -f .env ] || { echo 'deploy: no .env - it supplies VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN and VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY as build args (README, Deploy).' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run check && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && case "$VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN" in pk.*) ;; *) echo 'deploy: .env has no pk.* VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN, and the image build refuses without one.' >&2; exit 1;; esac && fly deploy --build-arg VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN="$VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN" --build-arg VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY="$VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY"

//: overrides.texture-compressor: texture-compressor is a command-line tool that @loaders.gl/textures only ever runs as `npx texture-compressor` from a Node-only encoder (dist/lib/encoders/encode-texture.js). Nothing imports it and it is never bundled. Its argparse 1.x pulls in sprintf-js <=1.1.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c), which has no patched release, and that one advisory was every deck.gl and loaders.gl line in npm audit. argparse 2 renamed the API texture-compressor calls, so this override breaks its CLI. That is acceptable only because nothing in this repo runs it; drop the override if anything ever does.
